steps.name: apply-vpd-coverage-and-audit-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = f0bcc1ed7d201a712784563d1d5acacebad55313; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9a/apply_stage9a.py > /tmp/growbox-stage9a.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/growbox-stage9a.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-vpd-dataset-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_input.py -q; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage9a/focused_vpd_gate.py > /tmp/growbox-stage9a-focused.py; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" .venv/bin/python /tmp/growbox-stage9a-focused.py; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tools/ml/climate_dataset_parallel.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add RH and VPD dataset coverage'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
